# Entry Point and Quality Gates Checklist: Walking Skeleton

**Purpose**: Review the quality of the requirements for the single entry point and the pull-request gates before tasks are written
**Created**: 2026-11-13
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK018 Is the list of D4 command forms that "apply to this project" (SC-008) written down, so it can be checked? [Gap, Spec §SC-008]
- [ ] CHK019 Are the health time limits per component specified, which the deploy edge case relies on ("within its time limit")? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK020 Is it specified which source file types the format command covers? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the comment standard that FR-025 checks defined in the spec or by reference to the constitution principle? [Completeness, Spec §FR-025]
- [ ] CHK022 Are the GitHub-native checks (code scanning, dependency review) named as the only exception to "only through this entry point"? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011, Plan R8]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK023 Is "a failing gate MUST name the file or finding" defined for each gate type, including scans with many findings? [Clarity, Spec §FR-022]
- [ ] CHK024 Is "formatting applied automatically when a contributor commits" clear about contributors who have not run the entry point yet (hook not installed)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-020]
- [ ] CHK025 Is "linting" defined per language (service and web app) or left generic? [Clarity, Spec §FR-021]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK026 Are requirements defined for the gantt submodule missing or not initialised when a command runs? [Coverage, Exception Flow, Gap]
- [ ] CHK027 Is behaviour defined when a pull request changes only documentation (are all gates still required)? [Coverage, Alternate Flow, Gap]
- [ ] CHK028 Are requirements defined for running D4 and road-map on the same machine at the same time (names, ports)? [Coverage, Plan R4/R6]
- [ ] CHK029 Is the "deploy twice changes nothing" edge case stated as a requirement, not only an edge case? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Measurability

- [ ] CHK030 Is SC-007's "under 15 minutes" measured from push to last gate result, on a named runner type? [Measurability, Spec §SC-007]
- [ ] CHK031 Are SC-001 and SC-002 measured on a defined reference machine or network condition? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, §SC-002]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [ ] CHK032 Is the dependency on the gantt pnpm change (psimhadri1980/gantt#10) recorded, with what happens if it is not merged? [Dependency, Plan R3]
- [ ] CHK033 Is the assumption that hosted runners provide rootless Podman 5 validated or stated as a risk? [Assumption, Plan R9]

## Notes

- Defaults used, as in [security.md](security.md).
- Items CHK019, CHK026, CHK028 and CHK032 found real gaps; the spec was amended on 2026-11-13. Ticking them remains the reviewer's call.
